sinopsis.es: El regreso de alguien del pasado hace emerger recuerdos y experiencias traumáticas.
sinopsis.en: Inés is a retired housewife who visits her late husband’s grave every day. Between cigarettes, she confesses to him the small lies she told him while he was alive. But everything changes when Mabel appears—an old friend who has returned to her hometown after 40 years away. Mabel’s reappearance reopens a trauma that Inés had long forgotten.
